title: 10GB of additional Bandwidth & Storage Boost
text:
## 10GB of additional Bandwidth & Storage Boost
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000030822

## Overview
The Website Bandwidth Boost add-on increases the directory website’s usage limits so that it can accommodate a much larger number of website visitors.
The Website Storage Boost add-on increases the directory website’s storage limits so that additional media and files can be uploaded.
Default with Add-On Bandwidth 10 GB Add 10, 25, 50, 100 GB To Your Monthly Limit Storage 10 GB Add 10, 25, 50, 100 GB To Your Monthly Limit
Add 10, 25, 50, 100 GB To Your Monthly Limit
Add 10, 25, 50, 100 GB To Your Monthly Limit
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
